verdict.rationale: The firm's EC&VC page says it supports venture-backed companies 'from incorporation through to exit'. It guides clients through 'secondary transactions, strategic M&A, private equity processes' and 'work[s] as advisers for IPOs'. It also documents a concrete exit case: Flock, advised from start-up in 2017 through to its £80m acquisition by Admiral Group. missing for 10: any IPO case study or detail beyond a single passing mention, dedicated M&A/public-offering pages for venture-backed clients, independent corroboration of exit track record.
